notes.title: Update + More Fixes
notes.content:
In an effort to keep up with the latest hardware (aka 64 bit), we have posted a new version up compiled with the best and most compatible tools. I also snuck in some fixes for the Settings menu that people have been asking for.

I am still working on adding a joystick control that is fun. The problem is that a joystick is a lot less precise when compared to a mouse. But be assured that I am listening and working on it. As soon as I have anything that is fun, I will post it.

notes.title: Taco Truck Madness Needs Help In Greenlight
notes.content:
For fans of [i]Crystal Quest Classic[/i], we wanted to tell you that Game Mechanics has another game currently in Steam Greenlight looking for 'Yes' votes. It is called [i]Taco Truck Madness[/i]. It is a callback to SNES titles but with up to date graphics and sound. The gameplay is similar to console and arcade games of the mid-90s. The controls are simple. Making it to the end is challenging. It takes a steady hand to get passed all the things out there to get you. It is pure fun and will make you laugh. Give it a Yes vote so we see it on Steam!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=787220220]Taco Truck Madness Greenlight Page[/url]

notes.title: Crystal Quest Classic Goes Live!
notes.content: This action packed retro style arcade game is now available on Steam! Winner of many awards, it is a tough but fun  game from the early days of computer gaming. With sounds, graphics and gameplay straight from 1987, it is pure fun. Be the first to take a look. You will be talking to your friends about it soon. It is just that kind of game.
